content_blocks.text: The prostate is the only accessory sex gland in the dog and is palpable per rectum as a bilobed oval gland with a median septum.
Dihydrotestosterone (DHT) stimulates growth of prostate gland; 5-αreductase in prostatic epithelial cells metabolizes serum testosterone to DHT.
